triggers.name: Cluster RED (a primary shard is missing)
triggers.script: def h = ctx.results[0]; h.red = 'status=' + h.status + ' · unassigned=' + h.unassigned_shards + ' · initializing=' + h.initializing_shards; return h.status == 'red';

triggers.name: Node(s) missing from the cluster
triggers.script: def h = ctx.results[0]; h.nodes = h.number_of_nodes + ' of __EXPECTED_NODES__ nodes in the cluster · status=' + h.status; return h.number_of_nodes < __EXPECTED_NODES__;

triggers.name: Unassigned shards
triggers.script: def h = ctx.results[0]; h.unassigned = h.unassigned_shards + ' unassigned shard(s), ' + h.delayed_unassigned_shards + ' delayed · status=' + h.status; return h.unassigned_shards > 0;

triggers.name: Shard capacity over 80%
triggers.comment: The cluster stays green at its limit: only the creation of new indices fails (2026-11-10 incident). Same thresholds as the dashboard.
triggers.script: def h = ctx.results[0]; long used = h.active_shards + h.initializing_shards + h.unassigned_shards; long limit = h.number_of_data_nodes * __MAX_SHARDS_PER_NODE__; double pct = limit > 0 ? 100.0 * used / limit : 100.0; h.shards_warning = used + ' of ' + limit + ' shards (' + Math.round(pct) + '%) · new indices are rejected at the limit, even on a green cluster · status=' + h.status; return pct >= 80 && pct < 90;

triggers.name: Shard capacity over 90%
triggers.script: def h = ctx.results[0]; long used = h.active_shards + h.initializing_shards + h.unassigned_shards; long limit = h.number_of_data_nodes * __MAX_SHARDS_PER_NODE__; double pct = limit > 0 ? 100.0 * used / limit : 100.0; h.shards_critical = used + ' of ' + limit + ' shards (' + Math.round(pct) + '%) · new indices are rejected at the limit, even on a green cluster · status=' + h.status; return pct >= 90;
